sourceReviewed: RefreshAlbumResult derives earned values from RunRewardTotals and receipt/profile values from the actual workshop state. It selects the real MemoryOnly message and suppresses the green saved mark in MemoryOnly mode.
OpenAlbumResultStatistics only reads Session.Statistics, creates UI, and closes its modal; it does not perform profile I/O.

rootTestEvidence.executionOwner: Parent /root; reviewer inspected the archived result and did not invoke Unity.

verificationLimits: The 30 PNGs do not include a dedicated MemoryOnly result, nonzero/incomplete loss history, max-tier profile, or Apply-resolution confirmation state. Those behaviors were source-reviewed and existing relevant tests were included in the parent's full green PlayMode run; this document does not claim separate visual exercise of those states.
Screenshots establish presentation, not persistence/no-I/O by themselves.

residuals: The native result ribbons, ornaments and courtyard are simpler than the painted concept; actual modular assemblies and full foundations deliberately retain their real appearance.
4:3 result/settings compositions retain paper bands or additional blank space to preserve full illustrations and established no-crop behavior.
Help retains more real instructional copy and twelve bindings than the concept. Its short 720p layout is denser, particularly the Space / Esc keycap, but all content remains readable and visible.
The concept's illustrative prior/next level, unlock and loss examples are not invented in the live UI; current actual progression and losses are shown.
The pending-save and mission-statistics surfaces are real product states beyond the single static victory source; their exact existing semantics take priority over copying illustrative content.
assetsFreeze: Final Help spacing change saved before the parent's final PlayMode/capture/EditMode window. No further Assets edits during this QA.
